intro: Amber Kearnen is a sharp-eyed operative of SI:7 stationed deep in Westfall. From her concealed vantage point overlooking the plains, she monitors the illicit activities of the Defias Brotherhood on behalf of Master Mathias Shaw.

p: An agent of SI:7, Amber Kearnen serves as one of Stormwind's field scouts. Rather than walking the halls of Stormwind Keep, she operates under the open skies of Westfall, watching over an abandoned watchtower commandeered by the Defias Brotherhood. Under the direct leadership of Master Mathias Shaw, Kearnen provides critical oversight and briefing for covert operatives sent to neutralize Defias threats and gather intelligence across the contested countryside.
